probability_calibration_shadow.method: fit 5-point probability bands on earliest 70%; shrink observed hit rate toward each band's mean forecast using n/(n+50); score latest 30% only
probability_calibration_shadow.note: A positive shadow result is not sufficient for deployment: require a fresh untouched holdout and exact-market post-margin value evidence. This evaluation does not change picks or historical ROI.

exact_line_side_calibration_shadow.method: exact pick+line cohorts; fit on earliest 70%; shrink each cohort's observed hit rate toward its mean forecast using n/(n+50); score latest 30% only; sparse cohorts use raw probabilities
exact_line_side_calibration_shadow.note: Exact line/side calibration is an experiment only. A single split is not promotion evidence; require a fresh untouched holdout and exact-market post-margin value checks.

ticket_performance.interpretation: Ticket outcomes are dependent when tickets reuse the same legs. Compare them separately from single-pick accuracy; do not interpret the raw ticket hit rate as per-leg performance.

walk_forward_ou_model_evaluation.method: strict chronological walk-forward; each scored event only sees earlier settled events
walk_forward_ou_model_evaluation.note: Full-line O/U replay evaluation is a different population from Qualified Best picks and bookmaker-favourite 1X2/BTTS research.

qualified_best_poisson_same_fixture_comp.join_contract: exact product + event ID + O/U line + side; scheduled timestamps within 15 minutes; outcome must agree across ledgers

paired_cluster_bootstrap_loss_comparison.method: paired percentile bootstrap by product + event ID; all line/side selections for a sampled event remain together
paired_cluster_bootstrap_loss_comparison.note: Approximate uncertainty intervals account for multiple line selections within one fixture but not all dependence from recurring participants. These intervals do not authorize model promotion.

qualified_best_poisson_same_fixture_comp.note: This is a selected Qualified Best subset intersected with the model evaluator's untouched holdout. Compare Brier/log loss/ECE on this identical set; no model is promoted automatically.

efootball_gt_gg_ng.reason: The sample is large enough for a preliminary review, but the latest chronological segment must be considered and the archive contains market-favourite results, not independent Match Signal BTTS forecasts.

efootball_adriatic_match_winner.reason: Close-to-break-even favourite returns with wide uncertainty are not proof of value; recheck the latest chronological split.

efootball_adriatic_gg_ng.reason: Do not infer an Adriatic GG/NG record from eFootball GT; the latest stored coverage inventory showed no market ID 29 rows for Adriatic.

promotion_policy.preferred_range: 200-300+ settled observations plus a chronological holdout, not a mandatory waiting period
requirements: independent Match Signal probabilities for the exact market and side
positive post-margin expected value on frozen pre-event quotes
adequate calibration versus the no-vig baseline
positive chronological holdout evidence and uncertainty disclosed
stable exact-event settlement; ambiguous or stale rows excluded
paper-only shadow comparison before any change to production qualification

method_warning: All slices are descriptive and exploratory. Many groups are tested; group results can share events, participants, market quotes, and accumulator legs. Strong/weak cohorts are investigation leads, not causal explanations or automatic promotion/blacklist rules.
